response.rationale: R1 uniquely combines the ECG-documented atrial tachycardia (1:1 P-to-QRS narrow complex tachycardia with PAC-triggered onset) and the nonischemic severe systolic cardiomyopathy (EF 15-20%, no CAD). Broader heart failure or isolated arrhythmia labels omit one of the two key components, and AF-based candidates are contradicted by the 1:1 P waves.

rejected.why: Explains nonischemic systolic dysfunction but ignores the atrial tachycardia and PAC-triggered arrhythmia.
